newsitem.title: UK: Hepworth sees sterling hitting year profits.
newsitem.headline: Hepworth sees sterling hitting year profits.

text.p: British building products company Hepworth Plc said on Wednesday that sterling's current strength would hurt its overseas earnings and export margins by about 8.0-9.0 million stg in the current year.
"The group's UK and continental operations are maintaining their sales volumes with the underlying trading outlook positive," Hepworth said in a statement from its annual meeting.
The company said its half-year results would include an undisclosed charge reflecting a loss on the sale of Hepworth Refractories.
The company planned to continue cutting costs.

"Last year we incurred redundancy costs of 6.5 million stg, and the same expenditure level may apply in 1997, with much of it falling in the first half," Hepworth said, adding that it would also have a further increase in its pension charge.
Hepworth's shares fell 5.0p to 253.5 by 1125 GMT. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
